pending.why: The full CBS and IBS reference rates from 2027 are set by Senate resolution (EC 132 ADCT art. 130; LC 214 art. 14). Until they are published, 2027-onward packages can only carry the transition deltas, and scenarios that need the full rate stay unsupported.
The NF-e technical notes for IBS/CBS/IS fields are needed by Phase 84's document mapping, not by the catalogue.
